title: A steady spinning wheel
hook: Change elapsed time and predict angle turned.
misconception: angle turned stays fixed when elapsed time doubles.
objective: Apply Δθ = ωΔt to compare angle turned when elapsed time changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a wheel rotating at constant angular speed, Δθ = ωΔt. When elapsed time doubles, angle turned becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Δθ = ωΔt; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a wheel rotating at constant angular speed, with a nonzero initial result. If elapsed time triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angle turned?
recall.why: Apply Δθ = ωΔt under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
